content.title: About
content.content: The toddler meal “Pasta and Vegetables” is designed for children from 1 year old. It consists of finely cut whole‑grain pasta, gently cooked vegetables (carrot, broccoli, zucchini) and a small amount of vegetable oil. The dish is rich in carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals needed for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain pasta provides more fiber than regular white pasta.
Vegetables are steamed, preserving up to 90 % of their vitamins.
The meal contains no added sugar or salt, meeting WHO recommendations for infant nutrition.
Each serving is sized at 120 g of ready‑to‑eat product – an optimal amount for a small stomach.
The product is packaged in a sealed, freezer‑safe pouch for convenient storage.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta supplies sustained energy, supporting a child’s activity levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 aid protein and carbohydrate metabolism, promoting healthy nervous system development.

items.title: Contains vitamin C and beta‑carotene
items.content: Carrots and broccoli provide antioxidants that strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Supports bone health
items.content: A modest amount of calcium from the vegetable oil contributes to bone formation.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber improves digestion and helps maintain a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: Some children may be sensitive to gluten; in such cases a gluten‑free alternative should be used.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Vegetables and pasta must be fully softened to prevent blockage of the airway.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The dish contains minimal salt, but parents of children with hypertension should consult a pediatrician.

items.title: Storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the portion in the microwave or on the stove to about 37 °C, stir with a fork until smooth, and serve immediately. If desired, add a small amount of infant‑appropriate dairy product.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened packages in a cool, dry place at 0 °C to +25 °C. Once opened, keep the pouch sealed in the refrigerator. When frozen, the product retains quality for up to 3 months.
